title: How to Conduct Research That Makes an Impact
author: InfoPouch Team
excerpt: A practical guide to developing a strong research question, choosing the right methodology, collecting reliable data and presenting findings that matter.
body: 1. Start with a clear question. Narrow a broad topic into something specific and answerable.
2. Understand what already exists. Review papers, journals and reports to find where your work can add something useful.
3. Choose the right method. Let your question guide whether you use quantitative, qualitative or combined approaches.
4. Collect reliable data. Use relevant, accurate, well-documented sources, and consider privacy and consent.
5. Analyze, don’t assume. Let the evidence shape your conclusions and acknowledge limitations.
6. Make findings easy to understand. Clear language and visuals help readers see what you did, what you found and why it matters.
7. Share your work. Research gains value when others can discover, question and build on it.
